sections.heading: First-line response (draft paraphrase)
sections.text: Communicate sensitively with children who may have experienced maltreatment. Attend to safety, offer first-line support, and consider appropriate reporting procedures.

title: Responding to children and adolescents who have been sexually abused

sections.heading: Trauma-informed care (draft paraphrase)
sections.text: Respond empathetically, promote safety, offer choices, and respect the wishes and autonomy of children and adolescents.

sections.heading: Core actions (draft paraphrase)
sections.text: Offer compassionate, non-intrusive contact, safety and comfort. Help with immediate concerns, practical needs, coping, and connections to supportive people and services.
